title: A method based on 10B isotope tracer for seepage detection in salt lakes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30276-30284
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02724A, Paper
Open Access

Jikui Hu, Yufei Deng, Lingfen Wang, Huang Wang, Liangliang Zhao, Liling Lu, Zhongjian Liu, Qiang Wang, Minshan Shi
This study pioneers the use of 10B isotope tracer for brine seepage monitoring in salt lakes, establishing a high-precision system to identify seepage channels and characterize flow fields.
